data.name: The Mysterious Inflatable Island (4-1)
data.rules: For the invasion category, the runs are under the NSG category (No Start Glitch), which means you cannot do a spindash before the countdown starts to trigger the torpedoes earlier. Runs using this glitch are SG runs (Start Glitch) and should be in the "The Mysterious Inflatable Island (Start Glitch)" level.

data.name: The Mysterious Inflatable Island (4-1 Start Glitch)
data.rules: For the invasion category, the runs are under the SG category (Start Glitch), which means you are allowed do a spindash before the countdown starts to trigger the torpedoes earlier. Runs not using this glitch are NSG runs (No Start Glitch) and should be in the "The Mysterious Inflatable Island" level.

data.name: Elevator Ambush (4-5)
data.rules: For the invasion category, both runs coming from "New Gen" (PlayStation 4, Xbox One, Nintendo Switch) and "Old Gen" (Wii U, PlayStation 3, Xbox 360, PC) are allowed. A specific leaderboard only for "OG" runs are in the "Elevator Ambush (Old Generation)" level.

data.name: Elevator Ambush (4-5 Old Generation)
data.rules: For the invasion category, only runs coming from "Old Gen" (Wii U, PlayStation 3, Xbox 360, PC) are allowed. Runs from "New Gen" (PlayStation 4, Xbox One, Nintendo Switch) are in the "Elevator Ambush" level (OG runs are also accepted in the other level).
